# @dxtmisha/figma-ref

> Reactive Vue 3 composables for Figma plugin development.

Bridges asynchronous Figma messaging and plugin state into reactive Vue `shallowRef` and `computed` properties, providing seamless two-way state synchronization, storage persistence, and canvas selection observers for responsive plugin user interfaces.

## Key Composables

### Storage Persistence
- [useFigmaClientStorage](src/composables/useFigmaClientStorage.ts): Reactive Vue `shallowRef` bound to `figma.clientStorage` with loading state and echo-suppression.
- [useFigmaStorage](src/composables/useFigmaStorage.ts): Reactive Vue `shallowRef` bound to Figma node or document persistent storage (`pluginData`).
- [useFigmaStorageMulti](src/composables/useFigmaStorageMulti.ts): Hybrid composable synchronizing data across document storage and client storage with dynamic flags (`inDocument`, `inLocal`) and fallback resolution.

### Canvas & Frame Observers
- [useFigmaFrameSelection](src/composables/useFigmaFrameSelection.ts): Composable to observe active canvas frame selections and programmatically update selections via `setSelection(id)`.
- [useFigmaFrameStyles](src/composables/useFigmaFrameStyles.ts): Reactive observer for Figma frame CSS styles and visual properties with `send(attributes)` style querying.
- [useFigmaUiFrames](src/composables/useFigmaUiFrames.ts): Reactive collection of top-level frames (`frames`, `loading`) for navigation lists and layer trees.
- [useFigmaUiSelected](src/composables/useFigmaUiSelected.ts): Reactive management of UI-selected frames with `selected` list, boolean helper `isSelected(id)`, and `toggleSelected(id, selected)`.
